    [mild] Theorem 3, the core case: assembly #

    CoreHyp P (no mild contour with ρ = ω' ≫ α) from the three cases of [mild] Lemma 2.2: penny-farthing (ω' invertible, the arrow before α is α), dumb-bell (ω' invertible, the arrow before α is β) and diamond (ω' not invertible).

    The penny-farthing case is split into the closed case (PFData.closed_false: ρ³ is projective-injective) and the open case (PFData.open_false, a tiny penny-farthing point), the latter possibly in Pᵒᵖ.

    The hypotheses of coreHyp are PFOpenStmt, DBStmt and DiamondStmt.

    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.DBData {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (x y : RayVert P) :
    Type

    Contour data in case (DB) of [mild] Lemma 2.2: v = q β α, w = w' β, α a loop at y with ρ = α.

    • α : y ⟶ y
    • t : RayVert P
    • w' : Quiver.Path x self.t
    • β : self.t ⟶ y
    • q : Quiver.Path x self.t
    • hval : pathVal ((self.q.cons self.β).cons self.α) = pathVal (self.w'.cons self.β)
    • h0 : pathVal ((self.q.cons self.β).cons self.α) ≠ 0
    • hni : ¬Interlaced ((self.q.cons self.β).cons self.α) (self.w'.cons self.β)
    • hρ (f : y.out ⟶ y.out) : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso f → ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ f = rpow (↑self.α) n
    • hωρ : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal ((self.q.cons self.β).cons self.α)) ↑self.α ≠ 0
